subject: Request: Marketing exchange for renewal — engineering hours in lieu of discount
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Marketing exchange for renewal — engineering hours in lieu of discount

Hi Vivek / Rishi,

Quick summary: Helixa is up for renewal (annual, $420k ARR) and is asking for a concession in the form of 0.5 FTE engineering support for six months to help finalize an integration for a pilot. They are offering a joint case study, logo permission, and a co-hosted webinar as the marketing reciprocity instead of a straight price discount.

Attached: Helixa_CaseStudy_Draft_v2.docx and SOW_engineering-hours_proposal.pdf.

Ask: I need an executive decision on whether we can approve the engineering-hours concession (they want the work scheduled and funded as part of the renewal start date) in exchange for the publicity package. Key constraints: engineering hours would be treated as a non-recurring professional-services concession (not reducing ARR), we need legal-approved brand/case usage terms, and marketing needs to sign off on the scope of the case study.

Why escalate: this is outside standard deal-desk authorities (engineering time > 120 hours). Helixa is strategic in healthcare analytics and visible in our target buyer universe — marketing sees substantial long-term pipeline value if we do a quality case study and webinar.

Timing: Helixa wants agreement before 05/10 to include the case study in their conference materials. They indicated legal will sign the DocuSign once we accept the non-exclusive publicity terms.

Proposed compromise: Approve 0.5 FTE for 6 months (capped hours in a SOW), conditioned on: (1) non-exclusive 12-month usage of case study/logo with a mutually approved quote, (2) Helixa signs our publicity consent and indemnity language, (3) marketing gets final review of final assets.

If you approve, I will: finalize the SOW with finance, have Rishi circulate the publicity consent, and Marissa will own the asset timeline.

Thanks — I know this is time sensitive.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Marketing exchange for renewal — engineering hours in lieu of discount

Thanks Grace — high level: I support marketing-led exchanges when they demonstrably expand pipeline and don't create open-ended operational obligations. A couple quick questions before I sign off:

- Precedent: have we granted engineering FTE in prior renewals for publicity? If so, what was the measurement of success?
- Risk: how will we ensure the hours are capped and scheduled so this doesn't displace roadmap work?
- Legal: please confirm Helixa accepts our standard non-exclusive publicity terms (no exclusivity, no access to proprietary models/code).

Marissa — can you comment on comms value (likelihood of pipeline attribution) and whether a staged release (customer quote + logo first, full case study after NPS) would be acceptable?

If answers look good, I'm OK to authorize the concession conditionally. Vivek

On Mon, May 3, 2027 at 09:12 AM Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com> wrote: (see above)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Marketing exchange for renewal — engineering hours in lieu of discount

+1 to the proposed exchange with caveats. Marketing perspective: Helixa is a strong case study fit (healthcare analytics, recognizable buyer logos) and the webinar could generate high-quality leads if timed with their product announcement.

Requests from marketing:
- We require a 30-day review period on all assets prior to publication (final copy, visuals, and webinar slides).
- Rights should be non-exclusive and time-limited to 12 months with an option to renew only by mutual written consent.
- Any customer quote used must be approved in writing by Helixa legal; we will provide a draft and ask them to confirm or edit.
- We prefer a staged approach: logo + short quote in Q2 collateral; full case study + webinar in Q3.

I can commit to producing the case study and running the webinar if we get the SOW signed. I'll also have our comms lead manage the quote approval and social assets.

Attachments: I reviewed Helixa_CaseStudy_Draft_v2.docx and left inline comments (tracked in the doc).

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Marketing
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Marketing exchange for renewal — engineering hours in lieu of discount

Read and noted. I did an initial pass on the publicity language and Helixa Legal sent back redlines (attached: Helixa_redlines_case_consent.pdf). Highlights: Helixa wants the right to approve the final quote, to limit distribution to non-commercial channels, and they added a clause restricting use of their logo in paid paid-media without their separate approval.

Legal takeaway / recommended revisions:
- Accept non-exclusive 12-month usage but add a mutual termination clause if either party materially changes strategy.
- Ensure SOW explicitly caps hours (example: up to 520 hours over 6 months) and includes an escalation path for additional scope (change-order rate). Hours must be logged and invoiced as PS credits tied to the renewal, not a decrease to ARR.
- Marketing must confirm the final quote prior to publication (we will not approve unreviewed endorsements).

Given the redlines and the value Helixa provides, I'm comfortable escalating for conditional exec approval: approve up to 0.5 FTE (capped and defined in SOW) contingent on acceptance of our adjusted publicity consent and the DocuSign being executed with the agreed redlines.

If Vivek approves, I'll prepare the final SOW and push DocuSign with tracked changes.

Rishi
General Counsel (acting for publicity consent review)
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Romero <alex.romero@helixa.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Helixa Legal <legal@helixa.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Marketing exchange for renewal — engineering hours in lieu of discount

Hi Grace and team,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We appreciate the proposed cap and the staged release approach — that works for us. Helixa Legal reviewed and is comfortable with the non-exclusive, 12-month publicity window provided the final quote is approved by both parties and the logo use is limited to organic marketing channels (no paid ads) unless separately agreed. We've attached our internal light redlines to the consent form for your counsel to review (Helixa_redlines_case_consent.pdf).

We are prepared to sign DocuSign once Redwood confirms the SOW cap and the publicity consent with the minor change limiting paid-media usage. We need final agreement by 05/10 to hit our conference publishing deadline; if that works for you, we'll get our signature executed the day we see the final DocuSign.

Proposed next steps from our side:
- Redwood sends final SOW with capped hours and scheduling windows.
- Redwood legal returns consent form with mutual termination language and the limitation on paid placement as a redline accepted or countered.
- We execute DocuSign and schedule the recording slot for the webinar in July.

Looking forward to getting this over the line.

Best,
Alex Romero
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Helixa Labs
